populationSource.note: Current main re-resolved to the same audited 391-player Front Seven population across 68 schools.

gradingSemantic: CURRENT COLLEGE FOOTBALL FRONT SEVEN ABILITY RIGHT NOW across EDGE, interior defensive line and off-ball linebacker. 2026 leads, 2025 substantially stabilizes, older evidence is secondary. Grade role-adjusted football impact: pass rush, run defense, tackling, block destruction, pursuit, coverage/space value where relevant, assignment reliability, physicality and disruption. Sack totals do not mechanically outrank complete linebacker or interior value. No NFL projection, recruiting ranking, draft stock, fame/school prestige or future-upside bonus.
currentSeasonWeighting: Approximately 55-60% current 2026 performance/role, 30-35% 2025 demonstrated level, remainder older/context; conceptual guidance, not a literal formula. Injury/availability informs confidence and present role but does not mechanically erase demonstrated underlying ability.

evidenceSnapshot.note: Evidence frozen after the September 26-27 weekend so October 3 games do not create inconsistent within-position timing.
primarySources: Current audited Octagon HQ CFB Wheel Front Seven population and priority ordering
2026 official school statistics/game recaps and national/conference defensive leader tables
2025 official school statistics and Sports-Reference context
EA SPORTS College Football 27 Aug. 27 ratings baseline where exact player identity could be resolved; used only as an error detector
